To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the genetic alterations of papillary renal carcinomas are not restricted to chromosome 7 and 17.
partial chromosome 20 duplications are frequent genetic changes in papillary RCC, and they are located at 4 noncontiguous genomic regions.
duplications of DNA sequences at 20q12 and 20q13 are frequent genetic alterations in papillary RCC.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of the genes at regions A, B, C, and D.
the identification of the genes responsible for the development of papillary RCC and the progression to a malignant phenotype.
the definition of new tumor gene loci at chromosome 20 in papillary RCC.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
papillary RCC is a genetically complex tumor type with a high frequency of genetic changes at chromosome 20.

duplications of DNA sequences at 20q regions A, B, C, and D are common genetic changes in papillary RCC and that these duplications are associated with the progression from low- to high-grade papillary RCC.
duplications of the genomic sequences between D20S478/D20S206 at region B and D20S902/D20S480 at region D mark the new tumor genes of papillary RCC.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the regions B and D are the most promising targets for further analysis of papillary RCC.
the genetic alterations at regions B and C and at the distal part of region D are associated with the progression and aggressiveness of papillary RCC.
the genetic changes at chromosome 20 were associated with the development and progression of papillary RCC.
The main takeaway from our work is that
duplications of DNA sequences at regions A, B, C, and D mark new tumor genes that are involved in papillary RCC.
duplications of DNA sequences at regions B and D are associated with the progression from low- to high-grade papillary RCC.
genetic alterations of chromosome 20 are common and frequent in papillary RCC.
